newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss launch three-month money market claims.
newsitem.headline: Swiss launch three-month money market claims.

text.p: The Swiss federal government is issuing three-month money market claims series 3.374 to be paid for on February 20, the Swiss National Bank said.
The allocation follows the end of subscriptions on February 18. The issue matures on May 22.
The previous issue of three-month claims series 3.373, paid for on February 13, raised 869.6 million francs and was priced at 99.627 to yield 1.481 percent annually.
